title: Dewarim: Item templates
description: Items from templates: variants of a base item by strength or quality (Strong, Potent and Mighty potions, Fine and Masterwork weapons), quick mundane items from rows typed or pasted like a spreadsheet, and riders that combine rules - a healing potion that heals more but poisons on a failed save. Merchants stock the variants; the studio builds them into adventures. System-agnostic, with a dnd5e adapter.

recommends.reason: Strength of heal and damage dice, riders with saves and conditions, rarity by price, coins
Shops stocked with the generated items, and crafters whose stock comes out better than plain
Generate straight into an adventure project
